key_insight: MentalHospital is a virtual psychiatry exam environment that tests LLMs across the full S.O.A.P. clinical encounter, not just isolated tasks.
clinical_relevance: It offers a more realistic way to evaluate whether AI can support psychiatric interviewing, assessment, diagnosis, and treatment planning in end-to-end workflows.
method: Built from 1,193 de-identified psychiatric EHR cases across major ICD-11 categories and 76 disorders
Uses skill-augmented standardized patients to simulate full S.O.A.P. encounters
Adds dual-track scoring: EHR-based objective comparison plus subjective process-quality review
evidence_signal: Clinician survey feedback rated the environment's clinical fidelity at 3.88/5, and MentalEval showed strong expert alignment with an average QWK of 0.944.
watch_item: The benchmark highlights that mental status assessment remains a major bottleneck, so strong performance on the platform may not fully translate to safe real-world psychiatric use.
paper_title: MentalHospital: A Virtual Environment for Evaluating Psychiatric Clinical Encounters
